name: Voyage 4
summary: Voyage 4 is a family of text embedding models from Voyage AI, part of MongoDB, released January 2026. The voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite and open-weight voyage-4-nano models share one embedding space, so documents can be indexed with a larger model and queried with a smaller one. Voyage also sells rerankers (rerank-2.5, rerank-3) through the same API.
facts: $0.12 / $0.06 / $0.02 per 1M tokens (large / base / lite); 200M free tokens
goodFor: Indexing with a large model and querying with a cheap one
watchOut: Closed models are API-only (Voyage API, MongoDB Atlas, marketplaces)
